review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part B (feature availability), fix round 1 after the review of PR 123: the successor of the part B admission at cloud-release-r74. The center changes: the operator grant and the operator role (account state, the account row lock, audited strangers, bounded refusal audit), the typed refusals of the entitlement service, the gate's answer to a failure and the checks of the operation table, the strict field names of the plan catalogue, the unexported test injection and the logging of the plan configuration. The Worker bundle is unchanged. The release profile now binds every non-test file of the executable's package (cmd/arcforges-center/operator.go, the commands that decide who may become an operator, was compiled into the image and bound by no record). The tests, the documents, the parity corpus and the browser acceptance package are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, base image, toolchain, legal file or migration changes. It supersedes the part B admission at cloud-release-r74.
